# Keyboard shortcuts

Shortcuts the workbench sets. They work in the 3D view with no tool open. You can change any of them in **Tools → Customize → Keyboard**.

| Keys | Tool | What it does |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| <kbd>S</kbd> <kbd>K</kbd> | [Sketch](tools/sketch.md) | Sketches on the selected plane or planar face. |
| <kbd>/</kbd> | [Command Search](tools/command-search.md) | Find a Solid Design tool by typing its name, then press Enter to start it. |

The command line (<kbd>:</kbd>) and repeat (<kbd>.</kbd>) are keys of their own: see [the command line](../guides/keyboard.md).
